role: Foundation study bundle for electronics, SiC MOSFETs, and embedded Linux.
use_when: A future board or Linux device needs a clean service model before hardware/software split is frozen.
how: Use embedded Linux concepts to design a minimal local service: /health, /version, /logs, /config, /diagnostics. Treat this as a lab standard before implementing on real boards.
production_part: Embedded Linux boards, lab fixtures, power-board diagnostics.

role: Offline cartridge architecture, manifest, local-first storage, and integrity.
use_when: The cartridge reader must expose status, verify/commit actions, and error receipts to the host without cloud dependency.
how: Expose a serial/USB local protocol for cartridge_inserted, manifest_verified, commit_started, commit_done, rollback, and fault states. Provide JSON receipts for every read/write/verify cycle.
production_part: Cartridge reader service, host validator, local maintenance UI.

role: First EVT/CAD implementation of the 8MB module.
use_when: The prototype needs a PC test utility or browser-facing local service for bench validation.
how: Map firmware serial commands to a small local API and generate validation receipts: flash_id, read_verify, write_verify, power_loss_recovery.
production_part: PCBA test service, fixture app, cartridge service bridge.

use_when: The flight controller needs safe local diagnostics before any tethered or powered motor test.
how: Expose read-only health endpoints first: imu_state, barometer_state, flash_log_state, arming_state, battery_state. Keep motor/arming commands behind a physical-safe gate.
production_part: Ground test dashboard, tether-test service, blackbox log extractor.

role: Open-source quadruped robot research and productization study.
use_when: The robot needs local operation, gait state visibility, calibration, and service diagnostics.
how: Bridge ROS2 topics/services into a local dashboard with strict command permissions: observe, calibrate, enable torque, safe pose, walk mode, emergency stop.
production_part: ROS2 service UI, field maintenance interface, education dashboard.

role: Agriculture automation, CNC-style gantry, electronics, firmware, web app, and tool ecosystem.
use_when: A farm-side system must keep working with poor internet or no cloud access.
how: Provide local queue, axis status, tool status, water state, job receipt, manual jog, stop command, and offline sync boundary.
production_part: Local farm controller, maintenance app, toolhead service interface.

role: Open-source lab microscope and precision positioning platform.
use_when: The microscope must expose capture, focus, illumination, stage movement, and calibration locally.
how: Use local HTTP/API commands for image capture, focus sweep, stage move, illumination level, objective profile, and calibration receipt export.
production_part: Microscope local server, calibration dashboard, lab evidence API.

role: Open satellite ground-station stack: antenna, SDR, Linux station, observation workflow.
use_when: The station must be monitored locally for RF chain, observations, scheduler, disk, network, and rotator state.
how: Expose local status page and API for sdr_detected, antenna_profile, observation_active, last_pass, decode_status, storage_free, and fault history.
production_part: Ground-station dashboard, RF commissioning service, observation receipt generator.

role: High-performance open-source 3D printer engineering and kit/productization study.
use_when: A printer kit needs local control, status, and calibration without depending on remote services.
how: Treat Moonraker/Klipper-like local API surfaces as the pattern: printer_state, heaters, bed_mesh, print_job, emergency_stop, config snapshot, first-print receipt.
production_part: Printer local UI, commissioning dashboard, service workflow.

use_when: The charger needs local status, diagnostics, and integration while never allowing unsafe remote enablement.
how: Use a strict safety hierarchy: local API may request charging settings, but the safety controller owns diode/GFCI/ground/stuck relay/temp fault decisions. Expose RAPI/MQTT/HTTP read-only status first.
production_part: EVSE local dashboard, commissioning probe, charge log service.

use_when: A vision product needs video, events, model thresholds, and privacy state without cloud dependency.
how: Expose RTSP/HTTP/snapshot/event endpoints plus privacy controls, local-only mode indicator, camera health, model version, and storage retention settings.
production_part: Camera appliance UI, local AI event bridge, privacy evidence API.

project: BeagleV-Fire / Milk-V Duo RISC-V edge bundle
role: RISC-V edge computing, FPGA, AIoT, embedded Linux, deterministic IO.
use_when: An edge board becomes a gateway, accelerator, or deterministic IO node.
how: Create a board agent with /health, /temperature, /gpio, /camera, /fpga, /benchmark, /update_status, and signed local evidence receipts.
production_part: Edge service daemon, local web UI, factory validation endpoint.

role: Plastic recycling and small manufacturing machine ecosystem.
use_when: A machine control box needs local recipes, cycle state, heater/motor telemetry, and guarded commands.
how: Expose recipe view, temperature status, cycle counters, fault history, guard state, maintenance timers, and receipt export. Gate start/reverse/heater commands behind physical interlocks.
production_part: Machine HMI, workshop dashboard, process-run logger.

project: NASA JPL Rover / OpenAMRobot research bundle
role: Rover mechanics plus modern AMR/ROS2 robot stack.
use_when: A mobile robot needs local operation, diagnostics, route/docking state, and safe command control.
how: Bridge ROS2/Nav2/micro-ROS into a local UI with health topics, pose/map state, wheel/encoder diagnostics, E-stop state, docking result, and commissioning receipts.
production_part: AMR local operator dashboard, docking validation app, field service tool.
